scientific_integrity: Finite computations are exact and executable; topological claims are supported by elementary collapses, a sixfold join identification, and signed-permutation orientation. No independent mathematical validation, certification, or definitive publication-priority claim.
scientific_limitations: Shortest-path metric on the single 24-vertex McGee cage; no conclusions for other cages, alternate metrics, quotient integral homology, or homotopy persistence. The 2011-04-03 date refers to the earliest day-specific verified public foundational source (Adamaszek arXiv v1); the graph had been reported in McGee (1960) without a verified original publication day.
title: Complete graph-metric Rips persistence and orientation symmetry of the McGee cage
